$schema.description: The JSON Schema of this file, for editors: a path relative to the file (e.g. ../schemas/experiment.schema.json, as 'stratarec schema --out schemas' writes them) or a URL. The engine ignores it: it is not part of the file's content id.

expires_at.description: ISO date (yyyy-MM-dd) after which the experiment may not enter new manifests.

arms.description: Arm id → RFC 7396 merge patch; control arms are usually {}.

additionalProperties.description: An RFC 7396 merge patch of the pipeline and catalog: an object changes only the members it names, null deletes, an array is replaced whole. A new node or entry must be complete; 'stratarec validate' checks what the patch does to the baseline.

params.description: Parameter values; map-typed parameters are nested objects flattened to leaves (design 11.8).

type.description: int64, float64, bool, string or map<string,T>.

flow.description: Flow columns may be rewritten by later nodes on the same path.

default.description: Replacement for non-finite numeric writes; required for non-nullable numeric columns.

order.description: Semantic position; required unless role is fallback.

op.description: Operator type and version, e.g. TopK@1.
enumDescriptions: score = base × Π multipliers + Σ addends, with named, independently patchable terms.
Drops rows for which a boolean ColumnExpr predicate is false.
Evaluates a ColumnExpr for every live row and writes it to a column.
Appends the candidates a generative model names that the table does not have, from prompts rendered with Mustache templates.
Reranks the leading rows by scores a model gives them as one list.
Writes a generative model's answer for each leading row into a column, from prompts rendered per row with Mustache templates.
Reranks the leading rows in the order a generative model lists them, from prompts rendered with Mustache templates.
Maximal marginal relevance rerank of the leading rows using an embedding column.
Scores rows with a model: named inputs from columns, named outputs to columns, batched.
Concurrent multi-source retrieval with deterministic merge and entity_id dedup.
Reranks the leading rows by a model's pairwise preferences, aggregated into expected wins.
Limits rows per group within any sliding window of ranks; over-quota rows move down or drop.
Sorts rows by a score column (missing last, ties by entity_id) and keeps the first k.

role.description: fallback for nodes that only run as another node's fallback.

config.description: score = base × Π multipliers + Σ addends, with named, independently patchable terms.

multipliers.description: Named multipliers; experiments add, change or delete (null) single entries without conflicts.

config.description: Drops rows for which a boolean ColumnExpr predicate is false.

predicate.description: Non-nullable bool ColumnExpr; rows where it is false are dropped.

config.description: Evaluates a ColumnExpr for every live row and writes it to a column.

output_col.description: Column to write (declared under columns); may be a flow column read by expr.

config.description: Appends the candidates a generative model names that the table does not have, from prompts rendered with Mustache templates.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

output.description: The model's text output holding the answer: a JSON array of entity ids (integers for int64 keys, strings for string keys).

max_items.description: The most rows the node appends: the first new ids of the answer. Also the node's row limit, which sizes the request's candidate table (design 4.8).

rank_col.description: A column for each appended row's 1-based position in the answer: int64? or int32? (undeclared: int64?). Rows the node did not append have no value in it.

max_output_tokens.description: The most tokens the model may generate (design 5.9 rule 2), passed with the call.

config.description: Reranks the leading rows by scores a model gives them as one list.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

output.description: The model output read: float32 [1, -1], one score per row of the list, higher first.

window.description: The leading ranks sent as one list and reordered by their scores; later rows keep their order after them.

score_col.description: Optional column for each window row's score: float32? or float64?, missing outside the window. An undeclared column is float32?.

config.description: Writes a generative model's answer for each leading row into a column, from prompts rendered per row with Mustache templates.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

output.description: The model's text output holding the answer: the row's value.

column.description: The column written: nullable, since the rows after the window and the rows whose answer is not usable have no value. text?, string?, bool?, int32?, int64?, float32? or float64?; an undeclared column is text?, or string? with categories.

categories.description: For a string? column: the answers it allows, compared exactly; any other answer is not usable.

window.description: The leading rows annotated, one model call each; the rows after them stay missing.

max_output_tokens.description: The most tokens the model may generate per answer (design 5.9 rule 2), passed with each call.

config.description: Reranks the leading rows in the order a generative model lists them, from prompts rendered with Mustache templates.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

output.description: The model's text output holding the answer: a JSON array of window ranks or entity ids (see answer).

window.description: The leading rows the prompts show and the answer may reorder; later rows keep their order after them.

answer.description: What the answer lists: rank, the 1-based window positions {{rank}} shows, or entity_id, the rows' entity ids (JSON integers for int64 keys, strings for string keys). No default: the prompt decides.

unlisted.description: Window rows the answer does not list: keep them after the listed ones, in their previous order, or drop them.

max_output_tokens.description: The most tokens the model may generate (design 5.9 rule 2), passed with the call.

config.description: Maximal marginal relevance rerank of the leading rows using an embedding column.

embedding_col.description: Vector column; rows without a vector have zero similarity to everything.

lambda.description: Relevance weight λ in [0, 1]; use lambda_param to make it tunable.

window.description: Number of leading ranks to rerank; later rows keep their order. Default 50.

config.description: Scores rows with a model: named inputs from columns, named outputs to columns, batched.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

outputs.description: Model output name → column to write (float32 or float64).

config.description: Concurrent multi-source retrieval with deterministic merge and entity_id dedup.

quotas_param.description: Map parameter source name → quota (e.g. recall_quotas); a quota of 0 disables a source.

source_order.description: Merge order of sources; defaults to ordinal order of their names. Earlier sources win the primary source.

config.description: Reranks the leading rows by a model's pairwise preferences, aggregated into expected wins.

model.description: Logical model name, bound per environment.

version.description: Fixed model version; or use version_param.

version_param.description: String parameter (with an enum of allowed versions) selecting the version per request.

output.description: The model output read: float32 [-1], one value per pair, the probability that the pair's first (higher-ranked) row is preferred.

window.description: The leading ranks to rerank (at least 2); later rows keep their order after them.

max_pairs.description: Load-time ceiling on the pairs a request sends: window · (window − 1) / 2 above it is a config error. Every pair in the window is compared; none is dropped at run time. The default allows a window of 50.

batch_size.description: Pairs per model call; the calls run concurrently.

score_col.description: Optional column for each window row's aggregated score (its expected wins against the other rows of the window): float32? or float64?, missing outside the window. An undeclared column is float32?.

config.description: Limits rows per group within any sliding window of ranks; over-quota rows move down or drop.

group_col.description: Grouping column (int64 or string), e.g. item.creator_id. Missing values are never limited.

max_per_window.description: Maximum rows of one group in any window.

config.description: Sorts rows by a score column (missing last, ties by entity_id) and keeps the first k.

k.description: Fixed number of rows to keep; use k_param to make it tunable.

key.description: Key expressions; the first non-missing value is the sampling key.

columns_from.description: Expands to a model node's inputs, e.g. ctr_ranker.inputs.

field.description: Physical field name in the store.

default.description: Value used when the key legitimately has no value; makes the feature non-nullable.
